sources.title: NHTSA owner complaints, recalls and 5-Star Safety Ratings
DVSA MOT anonymised data, 2025 test results and items

resources.name: used-car-reliability
resources.title: Used car reliability by model year: complaints, recalls and Lemon Scores
resources.description: One row per model year with a Lemon Score or NHTSA complaint data.

fields.name: make
fields.description: Make, as DriveClue names it (Toyota, Mercedes-Benz).

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model, as DriveClue names it.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Model year.

fields.name: lemon_score
fields.description: Lemon Score, 0–100, higher is better. Blank when the year doesn't have enough data to score.

fields.name: provisional
fields.description: true for model years under two years old, whose complaints are still arriving. Blank without a score.

fields.name: score_model_history
fields.description: Part of the score (35%): complaints against the model's other years, 0–100. Blank without enough data.

fields.name: score_same_age
fields.description: Part of the score (25%): complaints per year on the road against all cars of the same age, 0–100.

fields.name: score_recalls
fields.description: Part of the score (20%): safety recalls against cars of the same era, 0–100.

fields.name: score_crash_rating
fields.description: Part of the score (20%): NHTSA's overall crash rating, 0–100. Blank when NHTSA didn't rate the car.

fields.name: complaints
fields.description: Owner complaints filed with NHTSA about this model year.

fields.name: complaints_crash_fire_injury
fields.description: Of those, complaints that report a crash, fire, injury or death.

fields.name: us_recalls
fields.description: NHTSA safety recall campaigns that cover this model year.

fields.name: us_serious_recalls
fields.description: Of those, recalls that tell owners to park the car, or that involve air bags, fuel, brakes or steering.

fields.name: canada_recalls
fields.description: Transport Canada recalls that cover this model year.

fields.name: nhtsa_overall_stars
fields.description: NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings overall rating, 1–5. Blank when not rated.

fields.name: epa_best_combined_mpg
fields.description: Best combined fuel economy of the model year's versions, U.S. miles per gallon (EPA). Blank when not listed.

fields.name: year_to_avoid
fields.description: true for the model's years to avoid: up to three years with at least 20 complaints and at least twice the complaints of the model's median year. Blank for BMW series, whose pages combine their trims.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The model's page on DriveClue, with every year's numbers.

resources.name: car-problem-mileage
resources.title: At what mileage car problems start: owner-reported mileage by model year and problem area
resources.description: One row per model year and problem area, up to six areas per model year.

fields.name: make
fields.description: Make, as DriveClue names it (Toyota, Mercedes-Benz).

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model, as DriveClue names it.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Model year.

fields.name: problem_area
fields.description: The part of the car the complaints name, in plain words (engine, transmission/powertrain, electrical system).

fields.name: complaints_with_mileage
fields.description: Complaints about this area that gave a mileage. One complaint counts once per area.

fields.name: miles_p25
fields.description: 25th percentile of the reported mileage, miles (weighted, see the method).

fields.name: miles_median
fields.description: Median reported mileage, miles.

fields.name: miles_p75
fields.description: 75th percentile of the reported mileage, miles.

fields.name: km_p25
fields.description: 25th percentile, kilometres.

fields.name: km_median
fields.description: Median, kilometres.

fields.name: km_p75
fields.description: 75th percentile, kilometres.

fields.name: model_year_complaints_with_mileage
fields.description: All complaints about this model year that gave a mileage.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The model's page on DriveClue, with every year's numbers.

resources.name: car-complaints-by-state-and-model
resources.title: Car complaints by U.S. state: NHTSA owner complaints by state, model and problem area: By state and model
resources.description: One row per state and model with at least one complaint.

fields.name: state_code
fields.description: USPS state code (TX, DC).

fields.name: state
fields.description: State name.

fields.name: make
fields.description: Make, as DriveClue names it (Toyota, Mercedes-Benz).

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model, as DriveClue names it.

fields.name: complaints
fields.description: Complaints from the state's owners about this model, all model years from 2010 on.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The model's page on DriveClue, with every year's numbers.

resources.name: car-complaints-by-state-and-area
resources.title: Car complaints by U.S. state: NHTSA owner complaints by state, model and problem area: By state and problem area
resources.description: One row per state and problem area.

fields.name: state_code
fields.description: USPS state code (TX, DC).

fields.name: state
fields.description: State name.

fields.name: problem_area
fields.description: The part of the car the complaints name, in plain words.

fields.name: complaints
fields.description: Complaints from the state's owners naming this area. One complaint can name several areas.

fields.name: state_complaints
fields.description: All complaints from the state's owners, each counted once.

resources.name: uk-mot-2025-failure-rates
resources.title: UK MOT failure rates by make, model and year first used (2025)
resources.description: One row per model and year first used with at least 500 first tests in 2025.

fields.name: make
fields.description: Make, as DriveClue names it (Toyota, Mercedes-Benz).

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model, as DriveClue groups DVSA's model names.

fields.name: first_used
fields.description: Year the vehicle was first used (registered).

fields.name: tests
fields.description: First MOT tests in 2025 (retests left out).

fields.name: fail_rate_pct
fields.description: Share of those tests that failed, %. A fail is F or PRS (a defect fixed during the test), as DVSA reports it.

fields.name: average_miles
fields.description: Average odometer reading at the test, miles.

fields.name: tyres_fail_pct
fields.description: Share of tests failing on tyres, %.

fields.name: brakes_fail_pct
fields.description: Share of tests failing on brakes, %.

fields.name: suspension_fail_pct
fields.description: Share of tests failing on suspension, %.

fields.name: lights_fail_pct
fields.description: Share of tests failing on lights and electrics, %.

fields.name: all_vehicles_fail_rate_pct
fields.description: Failure rate of every car and light van first used in the same year, %.
